item.title: Southwest Basketball
item.description: Southwest Lady Wildcats dropped a game Wednesday night to Norborne, 51 – 13. Norborne’s high scorers were Avi Leabo with 15 and Sarah Mansur had 14. Southwest girls put up 13 points with baskets by Charlee Warner, Timberlynn Palmer and Lark Diegelman.

item.title: Caldwell County Route D Bridge Open
item.description: The Route D bridge in Caldwell County is now open according to the Missouri Department of Transportation. The bridge over Shoal Creek had been closed following a routine inspection in June of 2024, due to advanced deterioration. The bridge was 70-years-old at the time. item.title: Resident of Mexico Sentenced In Fentanyl Conspiracy
item.description: A Sinaloa, Mexico man was sentenced in Federal Court to 20 years for his part in a Fentanyl Conspiracy. Thirty-four-year-old Raymundo Guadalupe Felix-Perez was sentenced to 20 years in prison without parole, 5 years supervised release, and a money judgment of $80,000.
